news.body:
## What moved
- The 53,000 euro instalment is paid, and last Sunday's lead risk is gone with it.
SBI sent the wire on Thursday evening, you forwarded the proof to the fees thread the same evening, and you closed the task yesterday morning. Last week this was the one thing on the board with no slack left in it.
- You got through the Business Foundations week with both dated items inside it done.
Class ran 12:30 to 19:00 every day from Monday to Friday. The Career Anchor scores went in on Thursday, four days before Liesbeth's cutoff, and your x360 self-assessment on Monday.
- Club 8 is Marie's to answer now.
You asked her on Thursday about checking in directly on 3 January. It had been the longest-standing late item on the board and there is nothing left on your side of it.
## What did not
- Harver has never been opened, and the Kraft Heinz application is dead until it is.
Dated the 16th, and no device has ever touched the task. Their own reminder says they cannot see your results while the application is unfinished.
- The x360 observers are still unnamed.
LearningBridge confirmed your self-assessment on the 16th and said no providers are listed. Nominations are dated 11 December and your observers then need until the 28th.
- Nothing has touched the French health cover since early October, and it is dated 10 December.
## Risks
- The KITAS is Locus's to pay now, and you stop working there on 6 December.
Chitra chased the sales order on Friday and Jishnu said he would update her shortly. The task is dated today. After the 6th there is no facilities team, no manager and no employer on the other side of it, so every week this sits costs you the only lever you have.
- Nobody has confirmed the money landed.
Marie Rose asked for your name and reference in the payment line and asked to be kept updated, and nothing has come back since Thursday. The extension she granted ran only until your visa outcome, which you already have. A mis-referenced transfer is cheap to fix this week and expensive to find in January.
- The career track is the one part of this board with nobody outside pushing it.
Harver, the x360 names, the PLDP assignments and the Launch pre-work are all yours alone, and they land in a December that already holds your last working day, the pre-reading on the 20th and three deadlines on the 31st.
## Put first this week
- One line to Marie Rose asking her to confirm receipt. It is the only open question left about 53,000 euros.
- Harver, and then the x360 names while you are still at Locus and your observers are still colleagues.
- One line to Jishnu on the KITAS payment, for the same reason.
